title: Sex Determination and Variation
summary: X and Y chromosomes, why boys and girls are born in equal numbers, and where variation comes from.
objectives: I can explain how sex is determined in humans.
I can explain why the chance of a boy or girl is 50%.
I can explain how sexual reproduction creates variation.
misconceptions: The mother decides the sex of the baby.
Having three girls makes a boy more likely next time.
Sex is decided by the same method in all animals.
